Q: My first programming exercises in College A:

Using printf is indeed a simple and straight-forward way to print strings to the console.

This can be done in other ways (e.g. printing the characters one by one using their ascii value), but I can't think of any way that offers some advantage over this simple approach (at least without specific constraints).

Q: Python ValueError while training Logistic Regression model A:

Simple (but limited) alternative

If a column has only two values

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

le = LabelEncoder()
X_train["column_name"] = le.fit_transform(X_train["column_name"])

Not recommended for columns with more than 2 categories.

Q: uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK permission issue A:

by now your issue is fixed, so this comment for others still facing the issue.
i had the same crash issue even when my project has the permission. so, search for the permission 'android.permission.WAKE_LOCK' through your project, there must be a library that is using this permission but limits the sdk version like this
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" android:maxSdkVersion="25" />

so, the solution is
in your project manifest just add a node replace like this
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" tools:node="replace" />

and this will fix the issue.
